goal: Find real working-time evidence that can eventually resolve to manufacturing brands, facilities, or useful geographic baselines without fabricating precision.

candidates.title: Working Hours and Wages in the Jordanian Garment Sector / Better Work Jordan worker surveys
candidates.working_time_measure: self-reported total weekly hours including regular and overtime in an average week
candidates.factory_coverage: workers randomly sampled across most factories participating in Better Work Jordan
candidates.factory_identifier: microdata access required; ask whether a stable anonymized factory ID can be supplied
candidates.brand_linkage: potentially indirect through factory identity + Better Work Transparency + Open Supply Hub
candidates.value: Closest known source to Open Worktime's core variable at worker level.
candidates.next_action: Request anonymized microdata containing weekly hours, survey round, and a stable factory identifier; ask for permission to publish only aggregated histograms.

candidates.title: Better Work multi-country impact assessment microdata
candidates.working_time_measure: worker-reported or derived typical-week working hours, methodology varies by country/round
candidates.factory_coverage: microdata collected in five countries and matched to compliance data by unique factory IDs
candidates.factory_identifier: unique Better Work factory IDs exist in the research system; publication/access conditions unknown
candidates.brand_linkage: potentially indirect through factory IDs/names + public transparency records + Open Supply Hub
candidates.value: Could create a repeatable multi-country factory-level evidence backbone rather than a single case study.
candidates.next_action: Ask Better Work research team for data dictionary, access terms, country/round coverage, factory-ID availability, and aggregate-publication permission.

candidates.title: Better Work Transparency Portal
candidates.factory_coverage: named participating factories for multiple Better Work countries
candidates.brand_linkage: not sufficient alone; use factory identity to bridge into Open Supply Hub and disclosed supplier lists
candidates.value: Entity-resolution bridge from Better Work research factories toward public supply-chain identities.
candidates.next_action: Test matching a small sample of named factories to Open Supply Hub and brand supplier disclosures.

candidates.title: Open Supply Hub
candidates.value: Primary bridge from factory identity to brand supply chains.
candidates.next_action: Expand only when a real working-time source needs a facility resolved; do not bulk-import factories without worktime evidence.

candidates.title: Better Work Vietnam research summaries
candidates.working_time_measure: weekly working hours; published summary statistics include worker sample sizes and distributions such as mean/SD/min/max
candidates.value: Useful validation/context while waiting for microdata, but not enough for brand/factory histograms.
candidates.next_action: Use only as context unless microdata access is granted.

candidates.title: WorkerLivesMatter / WorkingTime
candidates.working_time_measure: schedule span, not verified actual weekly hours
candidates.value: Useful for testing messy entity resolution and schedule semantics, not public core data.
candidates.next_action: Do not publish derived records without permission.

candidates.title: ILOSTAT country worktime context
candidates.value: Regional baseline only; must remain separate from worker histograms.
candidates.next_action: No urgent expansion until brand/factory observations exist.

candidates.title: Open Worktime city-level manufacturing survey pilot
candidates.working_time_measure: average actual weekly hours over the last four complete weeks
candidates.value: Fallback that can validate real collection, moderation, weighting, geography and histogram UX even before brand-level data is available.
candidates.next_action: If P0 external microdata access is blocked or slow, launch a China-first survey using the area-survey-v1 contract.
